requiredFindings.title: Correct the new reader description to match the accepted input grammar
requiredFindings.detail: The added row says CRLF-only line breaks and describes plain scalars as having no indicator. The accepted unit permits LF as well as CRLF and excludes indicator characters only at the start of a plain scalar. Its already-accepted vectors accept-block-plain and accept-no-final-newline contain LF line breaks, and accept-plain-flow-characters-inside accepts a[b]{c},d. Thus these are false restrictions in a new inventory description, rather than merely omissions. The package, role and generated flag are otherwise correct.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Describe line endings as LF or CRLF, with bare CR refused, and plain scalars as having no leading indicator. Change only the new inventory description and refresh affected candidate/record/subject pins for review; no code change or inherited-row override is needed.
